$comment: Consumer-side vocabulary of the legacy benchmark input shapes. Canonical records know nothing of the legacy file layout and keep no legacy navigation scenarios: the corpus paths, suite titles and fixture names come from migration/legacy-map (ADR 0008), and the exporter needs only these few fixed facts to speak the legacy shapes. The parity harness verifies every entry against the pinned legacy files, so a wrong entry shows up as a difference. Nothing here is evidence.
taxonomySourceNote: GENERATED PROJECTION from redact-secret/credential-evidence canonical records (see provenance-manifest.json). Not the hand-authored legacy note. Detector assignments come from optional externalRefs mapping metadata; supportStatus is product qualification and is supplied by an overlay (overlay-interface.json).
